subject: NimbleCloud onboarding: procurement checklist and conditional no-PO agreement
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Tan <sophie@nimblecloud.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NimbleCloud onboarding – procurement checklist and trial terms

Hi Sophie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is keen to spin up the 6-week trial and evaluate inference latency on our smaller models. Before we provision, our procurement team needs a quick intake so we can confirm billing and payment path. Two items I want to clarify:

- Will NimbleCloud require a formal PO for the initial trial (total anticipated spend ~ $8k)?
- If a PO is required, what is your billing cadence and invoice remit details? If you prefer an invoice-only path for trials, what documentation do you need from us to qualify for a temporary no-PO arrangement?

Attached is our standard onboarding checklist — if you can fill the vendor form (nimblecloud_onboarding_form.pdf) and indicate preferred payment path, we can accelerate. Looping Marissa and Karthik from procurement to help with any gaps.

Next steps I propose: Sophie confirms preferred path + attaches completed vendor form; Procurement (Marissa) confirms whether a conditional no-PO can be approved for a one-off trial and lists required evidence.

Thanks,
Camila
Camila Reyes
Solutions Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: nimblecloud_onboarding_form.pdf]

From: Sophie Tan <sophie@nimblecloud.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@nimblecloud.io>, Procurement Team <procure@nimblecloud.io>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NimbleCloud onboarding – procurement checklist and trial terms

Hi Camila — great to hear. Short answers:

- For pilots under $10k we typically accept invoice-only (no PO) provided customer signs a short trial agreement and we collect a W-9 or equivalent tax form.
- Billing cadence: we can issue a single invoice at trial activation or net-30 after activation, whichever you prefer. Remit: payable to NimbleCloud, 102 Harbor St, Seattle, WA; bank transfer details available on request.

I attached our onboarding form and a draft of the trial terms that reference the conditional no-PO arrangement (nimblecloud_trial_terms_conditional_no_po.docx). If Redwood procurement needs tighter controls, we can sign a one-off purchase order or add a clause for automatic suspension if usage exceeds the agreed cap.

Attached: completed onboarding form (PDF) and draft terms.

Best,
Sophie Tan
Head of Revenue Operations
NimbleCloud
[Attachment: nimblecloud_onboarding_form_filled.pdf] [Attachment: nimblecloud_trial_terms_conditional_no_po.docx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Sophie Tan <sophie@nimblecloud.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NimbleCloud onboarding – procurement checklist and trial terms

Hi all — thanks for the details, Sophie. A few procurement items we need to approve a temporary no-PO path for this trial:

1) Completed vendor onboarding form (good) — we need the remit details inside the form to match the invoice.
2) Proof of corporate registration and W-9 / W-8BEN-E (or local equivalent) if billing to Redwood US entity.
3) Purchase cap signed by both parties: trial cap = $10,000. Any spend beyond requires explicit PO or pre-approved card.
4) Liability cap language: we can accept the trial terms but need a 12-month mutual indemnity limit tied to fees for the pilot.
5) Single-point billing contact and billing email for receiving invoices (PDF preferred).

If NimbleCloud can supply items 2 and 5 and sign the purchase cap addendum, procurement can approve a conditional no-PO arrangement for the 6-week evaluation.

Action items: Sophie — please attach W-9 and confirm who will receive invoices. Karthik & Laura — I’ll need a quick review of the liability cap language; if acceptable, I’ll issue the temporary exception and create a titled vendor record in our system.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_no_po_exception_template.docx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Sophie Tan <sophie@nimblecloud.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NimbleCloud onboarding – procurement checklist and trial terms

Thanks — I reviewed the draft terms. A couple of suggested redlines to make the exception approvable by Legal:

- Change indemnity cap to "liability not to exceed fees paid under this agreement" for the trial period; specify renewal negotiation for production.
- Add explicit clause stating trial data will not be used for model training or resale without Redwood written consent.
- Add clause requiring invoice line items to include usage hours and model IDs to aid cost reconciliation.

If NimbleCloud accepts those three edits we can accept the conditional no-PO approach and Marissa can populate the vendor record and tag the account as "trial-no-po" with a $10k cap.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Contract Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Tan <sophie@nimblecloud.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@nimblecloud.io>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NimbleCloud onboarding – procurement checklist and trial terms

Thanks Marissa & Karthik — we can accommodate the edits. Attached is a signed onboarding form and a countersigned trial addendum that accepts: (1) $10,000 cap for the trial, (2) liability limited to fees paid during the trial, (3) explicit prohibition on using Redwood trial data for model training, and (4) invoice line-itemization by usage and model ID.

Attached: nimblecloud_signed_onboarding_form.pdf, signed_trial_addendum.pdf

We confirm invoices will be sent to billing@redwood.ai and will issue a single invoice at activation. Please let us know when the vendor record is in your system and we will kick off provisioning.

Warmly,
Sophie
Sophie Tan
Head of Revenue Operations
NimbleCloud
[Attachment: nimblecloud_signed_onboarding_form.pdf] [Attachment: signed_trial_addendum.pdf]
